description: This file contains the implementation of the UrlServletHelper class, providing utility methods for URL and request handling within the OFBiz framework, including setting request attributes, managing path aliases, and sanitizing strings.

classes.name: UrlServletHelper
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for URL handling, request processing, path alias resolution, and string sanitization within the OFBiz web framework.

methods.name: setRequestAttributes
methods.description: Sets request attributes related to delegator and tenant identification, accommodating multi-tenant setups.

methods.name: setViewQueryParameters
methods.description: Appends view-related parameters from the request URL or parameters to the provided URL builder, and sets corresponding request attributes.

methods.name: checkPathAlias
methods.description: Checks for URL path aliases and forwards or returns 404 errors as appropriate.

methods.name: invalidCharacter
methods.description: Replaces a range of special characters in a string with hyphens to sanitize it for URL use.
